personality_one_liner: A premium, dark, silent, and editorial training club where cinematic glass aesthetics meet high-performance utility.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards must not be flush to edges. Apply safe area padding correctly.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar, sticky headers, bottom sheets, and modal scrims.
Use 15% opacity fill over #151515 with 10-20px blur for cards.
Always include a 1px solid translucent border (#2B2B2F) on glass surfaces.
Pair blur with a translucent tinted base underneath.
dont's: Never apply glass to form fields or body text regions.
Do not use glass if it sacrifices WCAG AA legibility.

screens.name: Login/Demo
screens.purpose: Cinematic entry point showcasing the premium club feel, allowing login or demo persona selection.

states.loading: Centered sleek spinner in brand orange.
states.error: Bottom sheet toast with red error message and retry.

screens.layout: Full-bleed abstract obsidian/gold background. Gradient scrim at bottom 40%. Large logo at top. Primary action ('Login') and secondary action ('Demo Persona') in thumb zone. 52px height buttons, 16px radius.

screens.name: Paywall/Showcase
screens.purpose: Showcases premium plans (Project Reset 12, Shape, Forge) with a luxurious, editorial layout.
screens.layout: Scrollable list of premium cards. Each card uses glassmorphism (#151515 background + blur), 24px radius, 1px border. Plan specific accents: Shape uses pink (#D96E92), Forge uses blue (#6D9BFF). Sticky checkout button at the bottom.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A personalized dashboard showing weekly progress, today's workout, and macro summary.

states.empty: Onboarding prompt to start first workout.

screens.layout: Greeting at top left. Horizontal scroll for weekly progress. Large hero card for 'Today's Workout' with a dark fitness model background and vertical gradient scrim. Below it, a macro-resumo card. 24px padding between sections.

screens.name: Workout (Treino)
screens.purpose: Detailed view of the day's training, exercises, and sets, prioritizing fast scanning during motion.

states.empty: Illustration of gym equipment with 'No workout today'.

screens.layout: List of exercise cards. Highly tactical: bold metrics, clear checkboxes to mark done, prominent FAB for 'Form Checker (AI)' using gold accent. Sticky 'Finish Workout' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Diet (Dieta)
screens.purpose: Manages nutrition with a macro calculator and daily food list.
screens.layout: Top section shows macro distribution using segmented progress rings. Below, list of foods grouped by meal. Dark food imagery with gradients. Substitution action on swipe.

screens.name: Evolution (Evolução) & Challenges
screens.purpose: Tracks user weight, measurements, and showcases Before/After photo galleries.
screens.layout: Line chart for weight history at the top. Grid (2-col) of Before/After cards for Challenges. Filtering chips pinned under header with a glass background.

login_hero.alt: Abstract dark obsidian gold texture for splash

workout_hero.alt: Two muscular men posing in a dimly lit gym

diet_hero.alt: Healthy food and macros on dark background

challenge_model.alt: Fitness model in dark studio lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Obsidian (#0A0A0A) background, glass surfaces (#151515 / #1D1D1F), and transluscent borders (#2B2B2F). No lime green allowed.
Implement the primary buttons with exactly 52px height, 16px border radius, and font weight 500 (semibold look without going beyond 500).
Cards must use a 20-24px border radius, 1px transluscent border (#2B2B2F), and a low shadow.
Use SF Pro (system font) for iOS fallback to generic sans-serif on Android. Follow exact font sizing: 30-34px for titles, 20-22px for sections, 15-16px for body.
Bottom tab bar must accommodate 5 tabs exactly as requested (Início, Treinos, Dieta, Evolução, Perfil). Maintain linear monochromatic icons that colorize only when active.
Place the Community FAB on the bottom right, hovering directly above the bottom tab bar. Use glassmorphism on the FAB.
Every background image needs a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to #0A0A0A at the bottom) to guarantee text readability.
Use Gold (#D8B46A) specifically for premium elements and the Form Checker AI assistant badge.
Use Pink (#D96E92) and Blue (#6D9BFF) strictly as accents for the Shape and Forge plans respectively.
